rows.name: AI answer share
rows.meaning: Of the AI answers that named a brand, how often it was Fender or Squier.
rows.population: Every answer in the simulation battery, all runs, where the scorer resolved a brand. Unclear answers and errors are excluded.
rows.notes: Keyword scorer: an answer counts as a Fender win when it mentions Fender terms at least as often as rival names.

rows.name: Weakest category
rows.meaning: The prompt category where Fender is named least, and the rival named most there.
rows.population: Resolved answers per category; categories with fewer than 10 resolved answers are not ranked; the hallucinations category is excluded because its prompts name Fender products.
rows.formula: per category: fender_wins / resolved; gap = fender share minus top rival share

rows.name: Answers flagged for a wrong spec
rows.meaning: Answers that stated a product fact the rule set knows is false.
rows.notes: Four fixed text rules; each flag carries the rule text as its reason.

rows.name: Share by engine
rows.meaning: AI answer share split by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini.
rows.notes: Most archived answers have no engine stored.

rows.name: Last AI read
rows.meaning: When the simulation battery last wrote an answer.

rows.name: Healthy Featured Offer, authorized seller
rows.meaning: Share of active Amazon listings where a Featured Offer is present and the seller holding it is on the client's authorized list.
rows.formula: count(featured offer present AND seller authorized) / active offers
rows.notes: Unavailable until the client's authorized-seller list is stored.

rows.name: Featured Offer withheld above Amazon's outside benchmark
rows.meaning: Listings where Amazon shows no Featured Offer and the offer, including shipping, is above the Competitive External Price.
rows.population: Active offers with a benchmark reading.

rows.name: Featured Offer present
rows.meaning: Listings where Amazon shows a Featured Offer.
rows.population: Active offers with a Featured Offer reading.

rows.name: Who holds the Featured Offer
rows.meaning: Amazon Retail, a confirmed third-party seller, or not yet read.

rows.name: Amazon Retail share of Featured Offers
rows.meaning: Share of active offers where Amazon Retail holds the Featured Offer. A drill-down fact for a Partner-led brand, not the headline.
rows.population: Active offers. Rows with no active offer are excluded.

rows.name: Seller read coverage
rows.meaning: How much of the active catalog has a seller reading.

rows.name: Offers below MAP
rows.meaning: Listings priced under the client's minimum advertised price on any channel.
rows.population: Active offers with a stored MAP.
rows.notes: Unavailable until a MAP sheet is stored. The Keepa list price was removed as a MAP stand-in on 2026-10-08.

rows.name: Outside prices on file
rows.meaning: How many active listings have a stored price at each outside retailer.

rows.name: Partner bundles
rows.meaning: Active offers whose title marks a bundle, kit, pack, or combo.

rows.name: fender.com page found
rows.meaning: Checked SKUs for which site search found a fender.com product page.
rows.population: SKUs with a known Buy Box seller, checked in hourly batches.

rows.name: Pages missing additionalProperty
rows.meaning: Found fender.com pages whose JSON-LD has no additionalProperty block.

rows.name: Amazon attribute completeness
rows.meaning: Average share of 13 Amazon product-detail fields that are filled.

rows.name: Ecommerce cause of the AI result
rows.meaning: The claim that listing control and product-data gaps change which brand an assistant names.
rows.notes: No stored reading links one listing's gap to one answer.

rows.name: Price gap on suppressed listings
rows.meaning: Dollars by which suppressed offers sit above Amazon's outside benchmark, summed. A price gap, not revenue.

rows.name: Phase 1 uplift
rows.meaning: The annual uplift figure the current dashboard shows as $680K.
rows.notes: Formula shape stored; no input values stored.

rows.name: Enterprise uplift range
rows.meaning: The figure the current dashboard shows as $38M to $62M.
rows.formula: sum of four stored lines, low and high
rows.notes: Three documents disagree on the value.

rows.name: Open action items
rows.meaning: Stored actions that are not done, each tied to a registry row.
rows.population: Action rows with status other than done.

rows.name: Monitored ASINs
rows.meaning: ASINs in the monitored catalog, and how many have an active Amazon offer.

rows.name: Listings by category
rows.meaning: Listings grouped by the retailer category.
rows.notes: The six authored division names from 2026-09-29 are retired.

rows.name: As-of per reading
rows.meaning: One timestamp per source.
